googleReview._note: The 'write a review' link patients receive in the review request (ClinicFlow googleReviewLink). ONE edit to go live: paste https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=<PLACE_ID> (Place ID from Google's free Place ID Finder) or https://g.page/r/<code>/review into writeReviewUrl and set status 'approved'; then run `npm run tenant`. While placeholder, the tenant file sends null. stagingDemoUrl is the clinic's Google search panel supplied by the account owner: used ONLY by scripts/staging/setup-staging.py --demo-review-link so the review request can be shown on staging; never production.
